description:
Activate Tezzeret's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, targeting Astral Cornucopia and The Peregrine Dynamo.
Holding priority, activate Astral Cornucopia by tapping it, adding at least two mana of any color.
Activate The Peregrine Dynamo by paying {1} and tapping it, copying Tezzeret's ability, targeting Astral Cornucopia and The Peregrine Dynamo.
Resolve the copy of Tezzeret's ability, untapping Astral Cornucopia and The Peregrine Dynamo.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.name: Astral Cornucopia
uses.cardState: with two or more charge counters on it
